source: 团队原创合成工程示例，参照ETS Write an Email的学术/社交沟通构念；非官方真题、非模考评分。
title: 【演示】托福2026邮件写作 · 补上项目会议
material:
ORIGINAL PRACTICE TASK — NOT AN OFFICIAL TOEFL QUESTION

You are working on a campus research project. You missed yesterday's team meeting because a required laboratory session was moved to the same time. You need to catch up before the next project deadline.

Write an email to Alex, the student project coordinator. In your email:
• Explain why you missed the meeting.
• Ask for the meeting notes and clarify which tasks you should complete.
• Suggest a specific time for a short follow-up conversation.

Write clearly and use an appropriate, polite tone. The receiver should know what information you need and how to respond.

教学演示说明：约10分钟为本次学习安排，不是官方计时。作答与反馈均由Agent代演，保留首稿和修订，不记录正式分数或真人审阅声明。
goal: 写清缺席原因、资料与任务请求，以及具体跟进时间，让协调人能够直接回应。
criteria: 交代会议缺席的具体原因，并覆盖三个沟通要求。
资料和任务请求足够具体，给出可回应的跟进时间。
语气礼貌、结构清楚，语言基本准确，不影响读者理解。
first_draft:
Hi Alex,

I missed the project meeting yesterday because I had another appointment. I want to catch up. Please send me everything about the project. I also don't know what I need to do next. We should meet sometime this week. Tell me what works.

Thanks,
Sam
feedback: 【合成工程演示｜外部Agent代演反馈，非真人审阅或正式评分】你已经说明想补上会议内容，但收件人还不清楚你具体需要什么。把“Please send me everything about the project.”改成对会议记录、自己分工和截止时间的明确请求；把“We should meet sometime this week.”改成两个可选时段；按题目补上必修实验课临时调课的原因。最后用更礼貌的请求语气。
next_step: 保留首稿，补齐实验课调课原因、会议记录/个人分工/截止时间请求，以及两个具体可选时段，再提交修订稿。
revision:
Subject: Catching Up on Yesterday's Project Meeting

Hi Alex,

I'm sorry I missed yesterday's project meeting. My required laboratory session was moved to the same time at short notice, so I was unable to attend. I would like to catch up before our next deadline.

Could you please share the meeting notes and let me know which tasks I should complete and when they are due? That would help me plan my contribution.

Would you be available for a ten-minute conversation on Tuesday at 3 p.m. or Wednesday at 11 a.m.? If neither time works, please suggest another.

Thank you for your help.

Best,
Sam

retest.title: 【演示复测】托福邮件写作 · 调整图书馆工作坊
retest.material:
ORIGINAL TRANSFER PRACTICE — NOT AN OFFICIAL TOEFL QUESTION

You registered for a library workshop about finding academic sources. A required seminar has now been scheduled at the same time. Write an email to Ms. Rivera, the workshop organizer.

• Explain the scheduling conflict.
• Ask whether you can attend a different session and explain your availability.
• Ask what materials or preparation you should bring to the alternative session.

Use a polite tone and give enough detail for the organizer to respond. This is a new situation for checking transfer after feedback. No official score will be produced.
retest.response:
Subject: Request to Attend a Different Library Workshop Session

Dear Ms. Rivera,

I registered for Friday's workshop on finding academic sources. Unfortunately, a required seminar has just been scheduled for the same time, so I will not be able to attend that session.

Would it be possible to join an alternative session? I am available on Monday after 2 p.m. or Tuesday between 10 a.m. and noon. Please let me know whether either option is possible.

Could you also tell me what materials I should bring or what I should prepare before the workshop? I would like to arrive ready to participate.

Thank you for your time and help.

Best regards,
Sam
